meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会变成短篇网文市场分析师，基于榜单样本产出扫榜报告：情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警、值得写的方向，并标注样本日期、趋势可信度和下次复扫时间。
howto.when: 当你使用 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜 等命令，或问「短篇什么火」时触发。它会先问你平台和类型方向。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言的短篇榜
say.note: 会先问你平台和方向，再确定数据来源

say.text: 七猫短篇现在什么题材火？
say.note: 输出该平台的情绪排行与题材热点

say.text: 对比一下点众和黑岩的短篇榜单

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a short-web-fiction market analyst. From ranking samples it produces a scan report: emotion rankings, hot genres, trend warnings, write-worthy directions, plus sample date and rescan time.
howto.when_en: Triggers on commands like /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜, or when you ask what short stories are hot. It first asks which platform and genre direction you want.

say_en.text: Scan the Zhihu Yanyan short-story rankings for me
say_en.note: It first asks platform and direction

say_en.text: What genres are hot on Qimao short stories now?
say_en.note: Outputs that platform's emotion and genre trends

say_en.text: Compare the Dianzhong and Heiyan short-story rankings
